newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPWARD PRESSURE SEEN CONTINUING ON FINNISH MARKKA.
newsitem.headline: UPWARD PRESSURE SEEN CONTINUING ON FINNISH MARKKA.

text.p: *DEM/FIM nudges down to 2.9770 in early trade from 2.9805 at
1630/1330 GMT on Monday, then turns higher to 2.9785.
*Markka seen rising on overall strenthening pressures, but
early move in DEM/FIM due to weaker German mark against the
*Some dealers say the Bank of Finland may seek to dampen
appreciation but decline to predict intervention levels. "There
is a risk that somebody thinks we are going too far from the
3.04 ERM central parity rate," one dealer said.
